✦ About Supernova

Where Every Detail
Tells Your Love Story

Supernova Wedding & Event Planner is Kolkata's most trusted name in luxury celebrations. Born from a passion for creating magical moments, we transform your vision into extraordinary experiences that last a lifetime.

From grand Bengali traditional weddings with authentic rituals and decor to modern reception extravaganzas, we blend cultural heritage with contemporary elegance. Our team of expert designers, decorators, and coordinators work tirelessly to ensure every flower, every light, and every detail speaks of perfection.

Based in the heart of Kolkata, we bring the spirit of Bengal's rich wedding traditions to life — from vibrant Ashirbad ceremonies to breathtaking reception nights under a canopy of lights and florals.

✦ What We Offer

Our Signature Services

Every celebration is unique. We craft bespoke experiences tailored to your dreams, culture, and vision.

01 💍

Wedding Planning

End-to-end luxury wedding management from concept to execution. Every detail curated for perfection.

02 🪷

Bengali Traditional Weddings

Authentic Bengali rituals, shankha-pola, subho drishti and all traditional ceremonies elevated with grand decor.

03 🌺

Reception Decoration

Breathtaking reception setups with floral arches, draping, mandap design and dramatic mood lighting.

04 🎂

Birthday Events

Themed birthday celebrations from royal kids' parties to glamorous milestone birthday extravaganzas.

05 🍽️

Catering & Buffet Setup

Elegant golden buffet counters, live stations, and premium catering with authentic Bengali and multi-cuisine menus.

06 💡

Stage & Lighting Design

Concert-grade LED stage setups, fairy light canopies, and cinematic lighting that transforms any venue.

07 👰

Bridal Entry Setup

Grand floral arches, aisle decor, drone shots, and dramatic bridal entry experiences that steal the moment.

08 🍹

Mocktail Counter

Neon-lit, Instagram-worthy mocktail bars with custom signage, floral frames and creative drink presentations.

09 🏢

Corporate Events

Product launches, award nights, conferences and corporate galas executed with professional precision.

10 📸

Photography & Entertainment

Cinematic videography, candid photography, live bands, DJ setups and entertainment coordination.
